title.value: NL-PS-L3-A - Level 3a: One minimal GBB per section

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 3a test patient, in which every mandatory section except Medication summary has at least one entry with a minimal generic building block (GBB) and a generated narrative, and Medication summary has no entries, and has an emptyReason and a narrative. Conformancelab sends the bearer token you enter at test setup to your server. Use a token issued by your own system that gives access to your level 3a test patient, and only to that patient. Without a token the server may return the Patient Summaries of several patients; the script then tests the first one. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
